এটা continuous tense বলে is being আসবে এবং এটা এক সাথে থাকবে।

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৫৬) Box x contains 3 red and 5 black balls and bag y contains 4 red and 4 black balls. One bag is selected at random and from the selected bag one ball is drawn. What is the probability that the ball drawn is red?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Bags x and y are equally likely to be selected.
The probability of selecting a red ball = probability of selecting a red ball from bags x + probability of selecting a red ball from bags y.
Probability of selecting a red ball from bag x = probability of selecting bag x × probability of selecting red ball from bag x
= 1/2 × 3/8
= 3/16
Probability of selecting a red ball from bag y = probability of selecting bag y × probability of selecting red from bag y.
= 1/2 × 4/8
= 4/16
The probability that the ball drawn is red
= 3/16 + 4/16
= 7/16

⇒ x = 36.
